description: Implementation of the DiagnosisService interface for managing diagnoses within the OpenMRS medical record system. Contains methods for saving, retrieving, voiding, unvoiding, and deleting diagnoses, as well as handling diagnosis attribute types.

classes.name: DiagnosisServiceImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the DiagnosisService interface, providing methods to manage diagnoses and their attributes within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a Diagnosis object to the database.

methods.name: voidDiagnosis
methods.description: Voids a Diagnosis, marking it as no longer active.

methods.name: getDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Diagnosis by its UUID.

methods.name: getDiagnoses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active diagnoses for a patient from a specified date.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a specific encounter.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a specific visit.

methods.name: getPrimaryDiagnoses
methods.description: Retrieves primary diagnoses (rank 1) for a specific encounter.

methods.name: getUniqueDiagnoses
methods.description: Retrieves distinct diagnoses since a specified date for a patient.

methods.name: getDiagnosis
methods.description: Fetches a Diagnosis by its internal ID.

methods.name: unvoidDiagnosis
methods.description: Reverses the void status of a Diagnosis.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosis
methods.description: Removes a Diagnosis from the database entirely.

methods.name: getDiagnosisDAO
methods.description: Returns the Data Access Object for diagnosis operations.

methods.name: setDiagnosisDAO
methods.description: Sets the Data Access Object for diagnosis operations.

methods.name: getAllDiagnosisAttributeTypes
methods.description: Lists all diagnosis attribute types.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves a DiagnosisAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a DiagnosisAttributeType by its UUID.

methods.name: saveDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a DiagnosisAttributeType.

methods.name: retireDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Marks a DiagnosisAttributeType as retired.

methods.name: unretireDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Reverses the retirement of a DiagnosisAttributeType.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Permanently deletes a DiagnosisAttributeType.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a DiagnosisAttribute by its UUID.
